ideas.pitch: An AI-guided diagnostic workflow that cross-analyzes failed ration-shop biometric authentication logs with local demographic degradation patterns to resolve PDS exclusion errors.
ideas.problem_statement: AI for All: The Fingerprint That Won't Match
ideas.title: AadhaarAudit: Fixing PDS Biometric Mismatches in Rural MP
ideas.track: AI for All: The Fingerprint That Won't Match
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the core case study constraint by proving thorough thinking through detailed LLM conversation history and providing clear, actionable social impact for marginalized communities in Madhya Pradesh.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent supply chain workflow that audits fertilizer and seed token distribution logs to detect diversion black-markets before distribution seasons begin in rural MP.
ideas.problem_statement: AI in Agriculture: The Token Before the Seed
ideas.title: AgriToken Trace: Preventing Subsidized Seed Fraud
ideas.track: AI in Agriculture: The Token Before the Seed
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages multi-agent logic and anomaly detection patterns to demonstrate deep operational problem-solving rather than generic agricultural advice.

ideas.pitch: An explainable clinical decision-support dashboard analyzing rural primary health center records to flag neonatal sepsis risks within the first 28 days of life.
ideas.problem_statement: AI in Healthcare: The First 28 Days
ideas.title: NeonatalNavigator: First 28 Days Clinical Early-Warning System
ideas.track: AI in Healthcare: The First 28 Days
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs transparent risk scoring and clear clinical explainability which appeals directly to healthcare judges looking for high-impact, verifiable safety nets.

ideas.pitch: An interactive audio-intelligence mapping platform that transforms oral histories and archival field recordings of Gwalior's Gharanas into a discoverable tourism ecosystem.

ideas.title: SonicSanctuary: Uncovering Gwalior's Hidden Musical Heritage
ideas.track: AI in Tourism: The City of Music Nobody Hears
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines cultural preservation with unstructured audio intelligence, matching the exact winning profile of transforming messy real-world data into searchable insights.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered environmental analytics dashboard correlating stubble burning satellite telemetry with micro-meteorological logs across northern Madhya Pradesh districts.
ideas.problem_statement: AI for Energy and Environment: The October Smoke
ideas.title: StubbleSense: October Air Quality Log Analyzer
